column1: # One mutant per line: file <TAB> sed expression <TAB> suite that must notice <TAB> label.
# Run with tools/mutate_check.sh --all. Every expression must match EXACTLY ONE line; a
# pattern that stops matching (a rename, or a long line re-wrapped) is a hard failure, not
# a skip, because a mutant that silently stops applying reports a coverage it is no longer
# The sed delimiter is | so no pattern may contain one. A literal & in the REPLACEMENT
# means "the whole match" to sed and has to be written \&.
# The rule: every gate ships with a mutant proving it bites. A rule with no mutant is a
# rule nobody has proven is tested.
